scope: Frozen completed-fold snapshots until all eligible annual periods finish; no model promotion from incomplete coverage
bin_membership: Right-closed intervals, with zero included in the first bin; no evaluation-based bin tuning

bootstrap.unit: Paired whole HARP within each year; fixed models, calibrators, thresholds and bin assignments

uncertainty: Reuse original precision/recall/FP intervals; add paired Brier/log-loss difference intervals and conditional observed-rate reliability intervals. AP remains a point estimate. Seed spread is descriptive, not a confidence interval.
coverage: All seven original eligible years, including zero-positive 2018. Missing positive years must prevent a completed all-year gate. Original 2019-2021 calibration-class skips remain visible.
no_changes: No refitting, relabeling, new threshold selection or exclusions
Never overwrite a prior snapshot or report
